knobs.description: Backend and model as backend[-fp32]:name; the backend must be one of the installed STT plugins.

knobs.name: threads
knobs.description: CPU threads the speech to text model uses.

knobs.name: warm
knobs.description: Warm a new model with one second of silence before it replaces the old one.

speech.name: stt.faster_whisper
speech.summary: faster-whisper speech to text backend (prompt, hotwords, beam)

knobs.name: compute
knobs.description: CTranslate2 compute type of the Whisper model; takes effect when the model is rebuilt.

knobs.name: beam
knobs.description: Beam size of the decoder; higher can be a little more accurate and slower.

knobs.name: prompt
knobs.default: Vocabulary: Mira, Hermes, 3D printers, Sovol SV08, Onshape, OrcaSlicer, slicer, vault, timer, calendar, YouTube Music.
knobs.description: Vocabulary hint that biases Whisper toward the words said to the wall; an empty text turns it off.

knobs.name: hotwords
knobs.description: Extra words Whisper is nudged toward; empty for none.

knobs.name: language
knobs.description: Language code handed to Whisper.

speech.name: stt.sherpa_moonshine
speech.summary: sherpa-onnx Moonshine v1 speech to text backend

knobs.name: retry_min_s
knobs.description: A clip longer than this gets one more decode when the first comes back empty.

knobs.name: retry_rms
knobs.description: Loudness a clip must exceed before an empty result is retried.

knobs.name: retry_offset_s
knobs.description: Where the retry decode starts inside the clip.

speech.name: stt.sherpa_moonshine_v2
speech.summary: sherpa-onnx Moonshine v2 speech to text backend

speech.name: stt.sherpa_transducer
speech.summary: sherpa-onnx transducer (zipformer, NeMo Parakeet) speech to text backend

speech.name: stt.sherpa_whisper
speech.summary: sherpa-onnx Whisper speech to text backend

speech.name: tts.engine
speech.summary: text to speech engine with runtime voice, speed and loudness

knobs.name: voice
knobs.description: Her voice: a catalog voice id or alias.

knobs.name: speed
knobs.description: How fast she talks; higher is faster.

knobs.name: peak
knobs.description: How loud her replies are, as the peak level the audio is normalised to.

knobs.name: threads
knobs.description: CPU threads the voice model uses.

knobs.name: max_loaded
knobs.description: Voice models kept in memory at once: the active one plus one candidate.

knobs.name: warm
knobs.description: Warm a new voice model with one short phrase before it replaces the old one.

knobs.name: length_scale
knobs.description: Piper speaking length; higher is slower. Applies when a voice model is rebuilt.

speech.name: voices.catalog
speech.summary: catalog of every installed voice with stable ids, aliases and measured speed

knobs.name: rescan_s
knobs.description: How often the models folder is scanned again for new or removed voices.

knobs.name: featured
knobs.description: Voices offered first when she lists what she can sound like.

knobs.name: agent_max_rtf
knobs.description: A voice that is not featured may be set by voice only when it speaks at most this many seconds per second of audio.

knobs.name: rtf_file
knobs.description: File holding the measured speed of each voice.
